capabilities: Schedule tasks to day, week, month, quarter or year notes with date links
Show cascading task lists above the text in journal notes
Navigate and reschedule tasks from a sidebar calendar with week numbers
View and edit tasks in Bases as a table or board with drag-and-drop columns
Review overdue tasks one at a time and carry unfinished tasks forward
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; works on desktop and mobile. The author discloses that part of the project was developed with AI help. Full documentation lives outside the README, and two task markers ([?] and [I]) are experimental and off by default. No recurring tasks, times of day or stats, per the FAQ.
intentEvidence: Klaar plugs into Bases with two views, Klaar Table and Klaar Board, instead of inventing its own query language.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan checkbox tasks across periodic journal notes, so tasks scattered in notes are hard to see by day, week or month.

relations.evidence: Klaar plugs into Bases with two views, Klaar Table and Klaar Board, instead of inventing its own query language.
With the Style Settings plugin you can also tune the tag pills and the date chip colours.

summary: Minimal task manager that schedules plain Markdown checkbox tasks into day, week, month, quarter and year journal notes.
